title: InternOS private profile
description: Shape of the per-user profile stored in Cloudflare KV under key "profile". This file documents the schema ONLY — real values live in your gitignored private-config.json and are uploaded with `npm run setup:profile`. Secrets (Notion token, Groq key, Gmail tokens) are NOT here — they are Cloudflare Worker secrets.

name.description: Your full name, used in cover letters / emails.

email.description: Your email address, used in email sign-offs (not the recruiter's).

phone.description: Optional phone number for email sign-offs.

links.description: Optional portfolio links surfaced to the LLM.

resumeText.description: Plain-text dump of your resume / background. The LLM reads this to tailor drafts. Paste as much relevant detail as you like.

targetCategories.description: Category names (must match keys in config/categories.json) you want to keep. Empty array = keep every category.

locations.description: Preferred locations (substring match). Empty = no location filtering.

remotePreference.description: Informational hint for drafting; does not hard-filter unless a location is in `locations`.

tone.description: Voice/style instruction passed to the drafting LLM.
tone.default: concise, confident, specific, no clichés or filler
